summary: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-09-17, verbatim: 'i really dont like all this going back and forth and having to type in the terminal and everything. i created this system so i didnt have to work too hard to communicate to it. i would be willing to give the system and claude full access to my computer or any permissions it would need so that i dont have to do all of this menial labor'. Consequences: (1) the operator is never asked to type a command; anything a session can do, it does, and anything another machine must do is queued for that machine's next wake; (2) permissions.defaultMode set to bypassPermissions in ~/.claude/settings.json (the fleet guard hook still checks every command); (3) session start pushes any local branch not on origin (task dispatched); (4) record in OPINIONS.md beside the pace decision.
